summary_en: The study tests HCB101, an Fc-fusion protein that targets the SIRPα-CD47 pathway, in adults with advanced solid tumors or relapsed and refractory non-Hodgkin lymphoma. HCB101 is given as an intravenous (IV) infusion, and the dosing schedule and how often it is given are not stated. This Phase 1 study looks at safety, tolerability, how the body processes the drug, and anti-tumor activity, as listed in the official title.
summary_es: El estudio evalúa HCB101, una proteína de fusión Fc que actúa sobre la vía SIRPα-CD47, en adultos con tumores sólidos avanzados o linfoma no Hodgkin recidivante y refractario. HCB101 se administra como infusión intravenosa (IV), y el esquema de dosis y la frecuencia no se indican. Este estudio de Fase 1 analiza la seguridad, la tolerabilidad, cómo el organismo procesa el fármaco y la actividad antitumoral, según se indica en el título oficial.
who_for: Advanced solid tumor that is refractory to standard therapy or for which no standard treatment exists.
Non-Hodgkin lymphoma relapsed or refractory to at least 2 prior lines of therapy.
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 (solid tumors) or assessable disease per Lugano Classification (lymphoma).
ECOG performance status 0 to 2 and life expectancy of 12 weeks or more.
not_for: Known hypersensitivity to any component of HCB101.
Known active or untreated brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis.
Prior treatment targeting the CD47 or SIRPα pathway.
Positive for hepatitis B, active hepatitis C, HIV, or active or latent tuberculosis.
Known inherited or acquired bleeding disorder, or previously documented hemolytic anemia or Evans Syndrome in the last 3 months.
